[d0807] config | spool.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `spool.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
threshold_percent = 90
```

---

# `spool.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|

| Default | `95` |

| Component | spool |
| Unit | % |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `spool.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

[d0871] config | dlq.threshold_percent (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `dlq.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Usage level in percent at which the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | dlq |
| Unit | % |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `dlq.threshold_percent` only if you observe problems with the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[dlq]
threshold_percent = 90
```

---

# `retention.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 90
```

---

[d0365] config | retention.threshold_percent | version 4.x
# `retention.threshold_percent`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `95` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 95
```

ANSWER:
`spool.threshold_percent` sets the spool’s usage level (in %) at which throttling begins. Its default is `90` in PaderQueue 2.x and `95` in PaderQueue 4.x.
